title: Production auth: Cognito callback URLs and Google OAuth for apricity.anth.us
description: Set Cognito callback and logout URLs to https://apricity.anth.us (and localhost for dev); add the Google OAuth authorized redirect (Cognito domain /oauth2/idpresponse) and JavaScript origin for the production client; set Amplify secrets GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and ALLOWED_EMAILS for the production branch. Verify: an allowed email signs in end to end; a non-allowed email is rejected by the pre-sign-up trigger. Guide: /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus/docs/google-oauth-setup.md.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Env var APRICITY_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS set on app d2n7w4kwqyfwn4 = https://apricity.anth.us/,http://localhost:5173/,http://127.0.0.1:5181/. STILL NEEDED (user must set; agents may not enter credentials): branch secrets GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, ALLOWED_EMAILS for app d2n7w4kwqyfwn4 branch main (Amplify console: Hosting > Secret management, or SSM /amplify/d2n7w4kwqyfwn4/main/<NAME>). Google client needs authorized redirect https://<cognito-domain>/oauth2/idpresponse after the first successful backend deploy, plus JS origin https://apricity.anth.us.

comments.author: home
comments.text: User decision 2026-09-25: authentication is Google only (no email/password users). Amplify auth is always a Cognito user pool with Google federated through it; email sign-in exists only as a stopgap until Google secrets exist. Code is ready: setting APRICITY_GOOGLE_AUTH=true builds the pool with externalProviders only (replaces the pool, currently 0 users) and the dialog then shows only 'Sign in with Google'. TODO for the owner: (1) Google Cloud project + OAuth consent screen, (2) OAuth client (Web application): authorized JavaScript origin https://apricity.anth.us, authorized redirect URI https://apricity-anthus.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/idpresponse, (3) put GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET in Amplify Hosting > Secret management (branch main), (4) tell the agent; it sets APRICITY_GOOGLE_AUTH=true and APRICITY_COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX=apricity-anthus and redeploys. Needs 'aws login' again (session expired).

comments.author: home
comments.text: CORRECTION to the earlier instructions (per Papyrus docs/google-oauth-setup.md): Google's Authorized JavaScript origin is the COGNITO hosted-UI origin https://apricity-anthus.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com (NOT https://apricity.anth.us), and the Authorized redirect URI is https://apricity-anthus.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/idpresponse. https://apricity.anth.us is only in the app's APRICITY_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS (where Cognito returns the user). Also: Google Cloud Console is currently blocked for the owner's account until 2-step verification is enabled on the Google account (Google enforces 2SV since 2026-09-16); the owner must do that.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-09-25: Google-only auth is LIVE (Amplify job 17). Secrets stored by the owner in SSM /amplify/shared/d2n7w4kwqyfwn4/GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID|SECRET. Findings: Amplify requires email or phone on the pool even with Google, so email stays as an attribute and the pre-sign-up trigger refuses native sign-ups when APRICITY_GOOGLE_AUTH=true; defineAuth does not support domainPrefix in this version, so the Cognito domain is the generated 017d1deb91f43f32da66.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com (added to the Google client's origins and redirect URIs alongside the apricity-anthus ones). Remaining: owner signs in with Google once; then add groups admins+curators; then Import library from bucket.
